idea-plugin.name: LDAP Injection Sink Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a DirContext.search(...) call whose filter argument is built from an HTTP endpoint parameter -- CWE-90 (LDAP Injection): an attacker's raw input becomes LDAP filter SOURCE TEXT, re-parsed by the directory server.

Built on a real, hand-written RFC 4515 LDAP filter parser -- the FOURTH full custom grammar in this catalog (after regex, SpEL, and XPath). LDAP filters are fully PREFIX/Polish notation ((&(a=1)(b=2))) with no infix operators at all -- a structurally distinct grammar, not a variation on the other three. The grammar's job is noise reduction: it confirms the argument's static skeleton parses as a well-formed filter before flagging, never a security gate.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Java, only same-method taint; CodeQL and Datadog Code Security have their own rules for this category, but batch/CI or enterprise-SAST-only -- no dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
